formula: E[return] = E|move| x (P(right) x k_right - (1 - P(right)) x k_wrong); P(right) = monotone kernel share of right calls on |panel_pct| (bw 12, shrunk to 0.5 with 8 names), 5-point grid; log(E|move| + 0.3) = beta . [1, log expected_move_pct, log history median, log realised vol 20d], smeared
window: scorebord: BUY 13:30 ET on the entry day; SELL amc at the next open, bmo at 13:00 ET on the report day; gross
interval: 10th-90th percentile of the expectation over 500 day-block bootstrap fits; how well the expectation is known, not where the trade lands
